data.desc: Newegg is the go-to destination for tech enthusiasts and businesses ready to power what's next. For more than two decades, we've served builders, gamers, and IT professionals with a wide selection of PC hardware, consumer electronics, gaming peripherals, and lifestyle technology. Today, that includes the servers, workstations, and AI infrastructure that businesses rely on, along with the marketing, supply chain, and technical solutions that independent sellers use to grow.
